fields.title: Ye Yennyini
fields.body_html:
Njagala okwogera nammwe ku Yesu, era ku Yesu yekka. Emirundi mingi mpulira abantu nga bagamba nti, "Nnandyagadde okukwata ku Kuwonya okw'Obwakatonda, naye siyinza." Oluusi bagamba nti, "Nkufunye." Bwe mbabuuza nti, "Kiki ky'ofunye?" okuddamu oluusi kuba nti, "Nfunye omukisa"; oluusi nti, "Nfunye enjigiriza"; oluusi nti, "Nfunye okuwonya"; oluusi nti, "Nfunye okutukuzibwa." Naye neebaza Katonda kubanga twayigirizibwa nti si mukisa, si kuwonya, si kutukuzibwa, si kintu, si "kyo" ky'oyaayaanira, wabula kintu kirungi okusinga. Kye "Kristo"; ye Yennyini. Nga bino bwe biyita emirundi mingi mu Kigambo kye — "Yennyini yatwala obunafu bwaffe, n'yetikka endwadde zaffe", Yennyini "eyeetikka ebibi byaffe mu mubiri gwe ku muti"! Omuntu wa Yesu Kristo gwe twetaaga. Abantu bangi bafuna ekirowoozo naye ne batafunamu kintu. Bakiteeka mu mutwe gwabwe, ne mu mwoyo gwabwe, ne mu kwagala kwabwe; naye mu ngeri emu tebamufuna mu bulamu bwabwe ne mu mwoyo gwabwe, kubanga balina kokka ekyo ekiraga kungulu n'akabonero k'amazima ag'omwoyo. Emu ku ntuuko nalaba ekifaananyi ky'Etteeka Erisookerwako ery'Amerika, ekyayoolebwa n'obukugu ku kipande eky'ekikomo, ne kiba nti bw'okitunuulira okumpi tekiba kintu kirala wabula ebiwandiiko byokka, naye bw'okitunuulira nga kiri ewala, kiba amaaso ga George Washington. Amaaso gaayakira mu bisiikirize by'ennukuta nga oli ewala katono, ne ndaba omuntu, so si bigambo, so si birowoozo; ne ndowooza nti, "Eyo y'engeri gy'olina okutunuuliramu Ebyawandiikibwa n'okutegeera ebirowoozo bya Katonda, okulabamu amaaso ag'okwagala, nga gaaka okuyita mu byonna; so si birowoozo, so si njigiriza, wabula Yesu Yennyini nga Bwe bulamu, n'Ensulo, n'Obubeerawo obuwanirira obulamu bwaffe bwonna."

Nasaba ekiseera kiwanvu ndyoke ntukuzibwe, era oluusi nalowooza nti nkifunye. Ku mulundi ogumu nawulira ekintu, ne nkinywerako n'amaanyi ag'entiisa nga ntya nti nnaakifiirwa, ne nsula nga sikooye ekiro kyonna nga ntya nti kinaagenda, era mazima ddala kyagenda awamu n'okuwulira okuddako n'embeera y'omutima eyaddako. Mazima nakifiirwa kubanga saanywerera ku Ye. Nnali nsenamu amazzi matono okuva mu kidiba, so nga nnali nsobola bulijjo okufuna okuva gy'ali okujjula okuyita mu misulo egyagguka. Nagenda mu nkuŋŋaana ne mpulira abantu nga boogera ku ssanyu. Nnali ndowooza nti nnina essanyu, naye saalikuuma kubanga nnali sirina Ye Yennyini nga ye ssanyu lyange. Ekiseera ne kituuka n'aŋŋamba — nga akwatiddwa ekisa — nti, "Mwana wange, twala nze bunnyini, era nzikirize okuba mu ggwe ensibuko etaggwaawo ey'ebyo byonna, Nze Kennyini." Awo bwe nnaggya amaaso gange ku kutukuzibwa kwange, ne ku kumanya kwange okwakwo, ne ngateeka ku Kristo ali mu nze, ne nsanga, mu kifo ky'okumanya, Kristo asinga ekyetaago ky'akaseera ako, Kristo eyalina byonna bye nnandyetaaze eyampeebwa mu kaseera kamu, era emirembe gyonna! Era bwe namulaba bwe ntyo, kwali kuwummula kwa ngeri! Byonna byali birungi, era birungi emirembe gyonna. Kubanga nnali sirina kyokka kye nasobola okukwata mu kaseera ako akatono, wabula ne mu Ye, byonna bye nnandyetaaze mu kaseera akaddako n'akaddako, okutuusa oluusi lwe nfuna akatangaala ku ebyo bye kiriba emyaka obukadde bwe biriggwaako, nga tuli "twakire ng'enjuba mu bwakabaka bwa Kitaffe" (Mat. 13:43), era nga tulina "okujjula kwonna okwa Katonda."

Era bwe ntyo nalowooza nti n'okuwonya kwandibadde "kintu", nti Mukama yandintutte ng'essaawa enkadde eyaggwaamu, n'anzinga, n'ansindika ne ntambula ng'ekyuma. Si bwe kiri n'akatono. Nasanga nti Ye Yennyini ye yajja mu kifo ky'ekyo, n'ampa kye nnetaaga mu kaseera ako. Nnali njagala okuba n'eterekero ddene, ndyoke mpulire nga ndi mugagga; eterekero ddene erikuŋŋaanyizibwa olw'emyaka mingi, nneme okumwesigama enkya; naye teyampa terekero lya ngeri eyo. Sirina bwabwa obutukuvu newaakubadde okuwonya okusinga kwe nnetaaga mu kaseera ako. N'aŋŋamba nti: "Mwana wange, oteekwa okujja gye ndi olw'omukka ogunaddako kubanga nkwagala nnyo era njagala ojjenga bulijjo. Singa nkuwa eterekero ddene, wandikoze awatali nze so tewandijja gye ndi kaseera na kaseera; kaakano oteekwa okujja gye ndi buli kasseera, era ogalamire ku kifuba kyange buli kaseera." Yampa obugagga bungi, n'anteekerawo enkumi n'obukadde, naye n'ampa akatabo k'echeki n'ekiragiro kino kimu, "Toyinza kuggyayo kusinga kye weetaaga mu kaseera ako." Naye buli lwe waali weetaagibwa echeki, ku yo kwabaawo erinnya lya Yesu, bwe kityo ne kimuleetera ekitiibwa kingi, ne kikuuma erinnya lye mu maaso g'ensi ey'omu ggulu, era Katonda n'agulumizibwa mu Mwana we.

Kyandeeteera okuyiga okuggya obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo okuva gy'ali buli kasseera, okussa Ye Yennyini nga bwe nssa omukka, ne nzza ebweru nze kennyini. Bwe kityo, buli kaseera olw'omwoyo, era buli kaseera olw'omubiri, tuteekwa okufuna. Ogamba nti, "Kino si busibe bwa ntiisa, okuba bulijjo ng'ofuba mu buzibu?" Ki, okufuba n'oyo gw'oyagala, Mukwano gwo asingayo? Nedda! Kijja mu ngeri ya bwerere, awatali kufuba, nga ensulo, awatali kwerowoozaako, awatali kufuba, kubanga obulamu obw'amazima buba bwangu bulijjo, era bujjula ne buyiika.

Kaakano, Katonda yeebazibwe, mmulina, si kyokka kye nnina ekifo eky'okutereka, wabula n'ekyo kye siriiko kifo, naye kye ndifuna ekifo, buli kaseera, nga ŋŋenda mu bulamu obutaggwaawo obuli mu maaso gange. Ndi ng'akacupa akatono mu nnyanja, nga kajjudde nga bwe kayinza okukwata. Akacupa kali mu nnyanja, era n'ennyanja eri mu kacupa; bwe ntyo nange ndi mu Kristo, era Kristo ali mu nze. Naye, okwongera ku ako akajjula mu nnyanja, waliwo ennyanja yonna ennene ewala; enjawulo eri nti akacupa kalina okuddamu okujjuzibwa, buli lunaku, emirembe n'emirembe.

Kaakano ekibuuzo eri buli omu ku ffe si nti "Olowooza otya ku Besusani, era olowooza otya ku kuwonya okw'Obwakatonda?" wabula nti "Olowooza otya ku Kristo?" Waatuuka ekiseera we waaliwo akantu akatono wakati wange ne Kristo. Nkinnyonnyola n'olugambo olutono lwe nnalina ne mukwano gwange eyagamba nti, "Wawonyezebwa lwa kukkiriza." "Nedda," ne ŋŋamba, "Nawonyezebwa Kristo." Enjawulo eri wa? Waliwo enjawulo nnene. Waatuuka ekiseera n'okukkiriza kwennyini kwe kwafaananako ng'okuyingira wakati wange ne Yesu. Nnalowooza nti nnina okwekolera okukkiriza, bwe ntyo ne nfuba okufuna okukkiriza. Ekiseera ne kituuka ne ndowooza nti nkufunye; nti bwe nnaakuteekako obuzito bwange bwonna, kwandikwatiridde. Bwe nnalowooza nti nfunye okukkiriza, ne ŋŋamba nti, "Mponye." Nnali neesiga nze kennyini, omutima gwange, n'okukkiriza kwange. Nnali nsaba Mukama ankolere ekintu olw'ekintu ekyali mu nze, so si olw'ekintu ekiri mu Ye. Bwe kityo Mukama n'aleka Setaani okugezesa okukkiriza kwange, era Setaani n'akulya ng'empologoma ewuluguma, ne neesanga nga ndemye ddala nga sirowooza nti nnina okukkiriza konna. Katonda n'aleka ne kuggyibwawo okutuusa lwe nawulira nti sikyalina konna. Awo Katonda n'afaanana ng'anjogeza n'ekisa nnyingi, ng'agamba nti, "Toweeraliikirira, mwana wange, tolina kintu. Naye Nze ndi Amaanyi amatuukirivu, Nze ndi Okwagala okutuukirivu, Nze ndi Okukkiriza, Nze ndi Obulamu bwo, Nze ndi okuteekateeka olw'omukisa, ate era Nze ndi n'Omukisa gwennyini. Nze ndi byonna eby'omunda ne byonna eby'ebweru, era byonna emirembe gyonna." Kwe kubeera n'"okukkiriza mu Katonda" (Makko 11:22). "N'obulamu bwe ntambulamu kaakano mu mubiri," si mu kukkiriza mu Mwana wa Katonda, wabula "mu kukkiriza okw'Omwana wa Katonda" (Bag. 2:20). Ekyo kye kikulu. Si kukkiriza kwo. Tolina kukkiriza mu ggwe, nga bw'otolina bulamu newaakubadde ekintu kirala kyonna mu ggwe. Tolina kintu wabula obwereere n'obukalu, era oteekwa okuba bwaggule era mwetegefu okumutwala akole byonna. Oteekwa okutwala okukkiriza kwe awamu n'obulamu bwe n'okuwonya kwe, era oteekwa kwogera bwogezi nti, "Ntambula mu kukkiriza okw'Omwana wa Katonda." Okukkiriza kwange tekugasa kintu. Singa mba nsaba omuntu yenna, sandyesizze ku kukkiriza kwange n'akatono. Nandigambye nti, "Laba, Mukama, nze wuuno. Bw'oyagala mbeere olubuto olutwala omukisa eri ono, mpuuwa munda yange byonna bye nneetaaga." Kristo yekka, Kristo bw'omu.

Kaakano, omubiri gwo gweewaddeyo eri Kristo alyoke abeere era akolere mu ggwe bw'atyo? Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo alina omubiri nga ggwe, wabula ogugwe gutuukiridde; guba mubiri, si gw'muntu buntu, wabula gw'Omwana w'Omuntu. Wafumiitirizza ku nsonga lwaki ayitibwa Omwana w'Omuntu? Omwana w'Omuntu kitegeeza nti Yesu Kristo ye Muntu omu ow'ekyokulabirako, ajjuvu, akwata bonna, alimu byonna. Yesu ye muntu omu alina mu Ye yennyini byonna omuntu bye yandibadde n'ebyo byonna omuntu bye yandyetaaze. Byonna biri mu Kristo. Okujjula kwonna okw'Obwakatonda n'okujjula okw'obuntu obutuukiridde byassibwa mu Kristo, era kaakano ayimiridde ng'okusengekera awamu kwa byonna omuntu bye yeetaaga. Omwoyo gwe gwe byonna omwoyo gwo bye gwetaaga, era atuwa Ye Yennyini bwokka. Omubiri gwe gulina byonna omubiri gwo bye gwetaaga. Alina omutima ogukuba n'amaanyi omutima gwo ge gwetaaga. Alina ebitundu by'omubiri n'emirimu ebijjudde obulamu obungi, si ku lulwe yennyini, wabula ku lw'abantu. Yennyini teyeetaaga maanyi ku lulwe. Amaanyi agaamusobozesa okuzuukira n'okulinnya okuva mu ntaana, okusinga amaanyi gonna ag'obutonde, tegaali ku lulwe yennyini. Omubiri ogwo ogw'ekyewuunyo gugwa gwa mubiri gwo. Oli kitundu ky'omubiri gwe. Omutima gwo gulina obuyinza okusika okuva mu mutima gwe byonna bye gwetaaga. Obulamu bwo obw'omubiri bulina obuyinza okusika okuva mu bulamu bwe obw'omubiri obuwanirira n'amaanyi gaabwo, bwe kityo si ggwe, wabula bwe bulamu obw'omuwendo obw'Omwana wa Katonda. Onoomutwala bw'otyo leero, olwo tojja kuwonyezebwa kwokka, wabula ojja kuba n'obulamu obuggya olwa byonna bye weetaaga, amataba g'obulamu aganaggyawo endwadde, ne gasigala nga ensulo y'obulamu olwa byonna bye weetaaga mu maaso. Owo, mutwale mu kujjula kwe.

Kimbeera ng'ennina okubaleetera leero akakuumi akatono ak'amaanyi, ng'aba nti Katonda ampadde ekyama ekitono olwa buli omu ali wano n'aŋŋamba nti, "Genda obategeeze, bwe banaakikkiriza, kinaabeera kakuumi ka maanyi buli gye banaagenda, era kinaabayisa mu buzibu, mu kabi, mu ntiisa, mu bulamu, mu kufa, ne mu bulamu obutaggwaawo." Singa nnyimirira ku ssaana lino ne ŋŋamba nti, "Nfunye okuva mu ggulu ekyama eky'obugagga n'obuwanguzi Katonda ky'anaawa buwa, okuyita mu mukono gwange, eri buli muntu anaakitwala," nkakasa nti mwandyetaaze ekizimbe ekinene okusinga olw'abantu abandizze. Naye, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, mbalaga mu Kigambo kye amazima agasinga omuwendo. Omutume Pawulo atubuulira nti waliwo ekyama, ekyama ekinene ekyakwekebwa okuva mu mirembe n'emirembe (Bak. 1:26), ensi kye yali enoonya awatali kukiraba, abasajja abagezi ab'ebuvanjuba kye baali basuubira okulaba, era Katonda agamba nti "kaakano kibikkuliddwa abatukuvu be"; era Pawulo n'ayita mu nsi ng'akibuulira abo abaali basobola okukifuna; era ekyama ekyo ekyangu kye kino nti "Kristo ali mu mmwe, essuubi ery'ekitiibwa."

Ekigambo "ekyama" kitegeeza kyama; kino kye kyama ekinene. Era mbabuulira leero, weewaawo, nsobola okubawa, bwe munaakitwala okuva gy'ali, so si okuva gye ndi — nsobola okubawa ekyama ekiri gye ndi, owo, eky'ekyewuunyo bwe kityo! Emyaka mingi emabega najja gy'ali nga nzitoowereddwa omusango n'entiisa; ne ngezaako ekyama ekyangu ekyo, ne kiggyawo entiisa yange yonna n'ekibi kyange. Emyaka ne giyita, ne nsanga ekibi nga kimpangula era n'okukemebwa kwange nga kunsingira amaanyi. Najja gy'ali omulundi ogwokubiri, n'ampweekera nti, "Kristo ali mu ggwe," ne mba n'obuwanguzi, okuwummula n'omukisa.

Awo omubiri ne gutyobooka mu ngeri zonna. Bulijjo nnali nkola nnyo, era okuva mu myaka kkumi n'ena nayiga ne nfuba nga sisonyiwa maanyi. Nnatwala obuvunaanyizibwa bw'ekkuŋŋaaniro eddene mu myaka amakumi abiri mu gumu; nnaggwaamu ddala emirundi nga mukaaga era mu mbeera yange ey'oluvannyuma nnali nkooye ddala. Emirundi mingi nnali ntya nti nnaagwa nga nfudde mu kifo kyange eky'okubuulirira. Saayinza kulinnya wa waggulu wonna awatali kuwulira nga sisobola kussa, olw'omutima ogwali gutyoboose n'obusimu obwali bukooye. Nawulira ku kuwonya kwa Mukama, naye ne nkulwanyisa. Nnali nkutya. Nnali nayigirizibwa mu masomero g'eby'okwesimba nti ekiseera eky'ebyamagero kyali kiyise, era saayinza kudda mabega ku byanjigiriza mu ntandikwa. Omutwe gwange gwe gwali gunziyiza, naye ekiseera ne kituuka, bwe nnaleetebwa okwenyigira mu "kuziika kwa nkola yange ey'enjigiriza enkalubo," nga bwe Mukama Schrenck agamba, "Mukama n'ampweekera ekyama ekitono, 'Kristo ali mu ggwe'; era okuva mu kaseera ako ne mmwaŋŋiriza olw'omubiri gwange nga bwe nnali nkoze olw'emmeeme yange. Nnafuulibwa ow'amaanyi era omulamu ennyo ne ntuuka okumala emirimu nga ssanyu ddala. Emyaka mingi mmaze ekiwummulo kyange eky'omu biseera eby'ebbugumu mu kibuga New York ekyokya, nga mbuulira era nga nkola mu bantu abangi, mu ngeri gye nnali sikolangamu; okwongera ku mirimu gy'Amaka gaffe n'Ekitongole ky'Amasomero n'emirimu emingi egy'omu tterekero ly'ebitabo n'ebirala bingi. Naye Mukama teyaggyawo bulumi bwange bwokka. Kyali kisingako ku kuwonya obw'engeri emu. Yampa Ye Yennyini ne ntuuka okufiirwa okuwulira okw'obulumi okw'ebitundu by'omubiri. Ekyo kye kirungi ekisinga mu bulamu bw'awa. Neebaza Mukama olw'okunkuuma okuva mu kwerowoozaako omubiri okw'obulwadde n'omubiri oguleetera okweraliikirira, n'ampa obulamu obwangu obuli ssanyu era obuweereza eri Mukama waffe, obuli kuwummula n'essanyu.

Ate era, nnali n'obwongo obunafu, obuzito era obukalubo, obutaalowooza newaakubadde okukola mangu. Nnali njagala okuwandiika n'okwogera ku lwa Kristo era okuba n'okujjukira okwangu, ndyoke mbeere n'obumanyirivu obutono bwe nnali nfunye nga bulijjo bunfugibwa. Najja eri Kristo ku nsonga eyo, ne mubuuza obanga alina ky'ampa mu ngeri eno. N'anziramu nti, "Yee, mwana wange, nafuuka gye muli Amagezi." Nnali bulijjo nkola ensobi, ze nnali njejjusa, ne ndowooza nti sijja kuddamu kuzikola; naye bwe yagamba nti anaabeera amagezi gange, nti tuyinza okuba n'endowooza ya Kristo, nti asobola okusuula ebirowoozo n'okuwamba buli kirowoozo mu buwulize bwa Kristo, nti asobola okutereeza obwongo n'omutwe, awo ne mumutwalira ebyo byonna. Era okuva olwo, nnakuumibwa nga siriimu bunafu buno obw'omutwe, era omulimu gufuuse kuwummula. Nnali njawandiika nsoma bbiri buli wiiki, era kyantwalanga ennaku ssatu okumaliriza emu. Naye kaakano, mu mulimu gwange ogw'okuwandiika, nnina empapula ez'enkumu-nkumu ez'okuwandiika bulijjo okwongera ku kukulembera enkuŋŋaana ennyingi nnyo buli wiiki, era byonna bimpangira bwangu mu ssanyu. Mukama anyambye mu bwongo, era mmanyi nti ye Mulokozi w'obwongo bwaffe nga bw'ali Omulokozi w'omwoyo gwaffe.

Kale nno, nnali n'obw'okusalawo obutanywevu. Ne mbuuza nti, "Tosobola kubeera kwagala gye ndi?" N'agamba nti, "Yee, mwana wange, Katonda ye akola mu ggwe okwagala n'okukola." Awo n'anjigiriza engeri n'ekiseera eky'okuba omunywevu, n'engeri n'ekiseera eky'okuwaayo. Abantu bangi balina obw'okusalawo obunywevu, naye tebamanyi ngeri ya kunywerera mu kaseera akatuufu. Bwe ntyo nange, najja gy'ali olw'amaanyi ag'omulimu gwe n'ebintu byonna eby'okuweereza kwe, era teyanninnamu.

Bwe ntyo nandigambye nti, ekyama kino ekitono eky'omuwendo eky'"Kristo ali mu ggwe," bwe kinaakuyamba, oyinza okukyefunira. Osobole okukikozesa obulungi okunsinga! Mpulira nga ntandise butandisi okuyiga engeri gye kikoleramu obulungi. Kitwale weeyongere okukikola, okuyita mu biseera n'obulamu obutaggwaawo — Kristo olwa byonna, ekisa ku kisa, okuva mu maanyi okudda mu maanyi, okuva mu kitiibwa okudda mu kitiibwa, okuva kaakano n'okutuusa emirembe n'emirembe.

Edda gwali mukisa, Kaakano ye Mukama;

Edda kwali kuwulira, Kaakano Kye Kigambo kye.

Edda nnayagala ebirabo bye, Kaakano nnina Omuwi wennyini;

Edda nnanoonya kuwonya, Kaakano Ye Yennyini yekka.

Edda kwali kufuba okw'obulumi, Kaakano kwe kwesiga okutuukiridde;

Edda bwali bulokozi bwa kitundu, Kaakano bwe bulokozi obutuukiridde ddala.

Edda kwali kunywerera okutaggwaawo, Kaakano Ye ye ankwatirira;

Edda kwali kutwalibwa buli kiseera, Kaakano essikiro lyange lisuuliddwa.

Edda kwali kuteekateeka okw'okwewunga, Kaakano kwe kusaba okw'obwesige;

Edda kwali kweraliikirira, Kaakano Ye alina obulabirizi.

Edda kye nnayagala, Kaakano Yesu ky'agamba;

Edda kwali kusaba okutaggwaawo, Kaakano kwe kutendereza okutakoma.

Edda gwali mulimu gwange, Kaakano gunaabeera gugwe;

Edda nnagezaako okumukozesa, Kaakano Ye ankozesa.

Edda amaanyi ge nnayagala, Kaakano Ow'amaanyi;

Edda nnafubira nze kennyini, Kaakano ku lulwe yekka.

Edda nnasuubira mu Yesu, Kaakano mmanyi nti wange;

Edda ettabaaza zange zaali zizikira, Kaakano zaaka nga zimasamasa.

Edda nnali nnindirira kufa, Kaakano nsanyukira okujja kwe;

Era essuubi lyange linywezeddwa, nga likuumiddwa munda w'eggigi.

Omuntu wa Yesu Kristo gwe twetaaga. Abantu bangi bafuna ekirowoozo naye ne batafunamu kintu. Bakiteeka mu mutwe gwabwe, ne mu mwoyo gwabwe, ne mu kwagala kwabwe; naye mu ngeri emu tebamufuna mu bulamu bwabwe ne mu mwoyo gwabwe, kubanga balina kokka ekyo ekiraga kungulu n'akabonero k'amazima ag'omwoyo. Emu ku ntuuko nalaba ekifaananyi ky'Etteeka Erisookerwako ery'Amerika, ekyayoolebwa n'obukugu ku kipande eky'ekikomo, ne kiba nti bw'okitunuulira okumpi tekiba kintu kirala wabula ebiwandiiko byokka, naye bw'okitunuulira nga kiri ewala, kiba amaaso ga George Washington. Amaaso gaayakira mu bisiikirize by'ennukuta nga oli ewala katono, ne ndaba omuntu, so si bigambo, so si birowoozo; ne ndowooza nti, "Eyo y'engeri gy'olina okutunuuliramu Ebyawandiikibwa n'okutegeera ebirowoozo bya Katonda, okulabamu amaaso ag'okwagala, nga gaaka okuyita mu byonna; so si birowoozo, so si njigiriza, wabula Yesu Yennyini nga Bwe bulamu, n'Ensulo, n'Obubeerawo obuwanirira obulamu bwaffe bwonna." Nasaba ekiseera kiwanvu ndyoke ntukuzibwe, era oluusi nalowooza nti nkifunye. Ku mulundi ogumu nawulira ekintu, ne nkinywerako n'amaanyi ag'entiisa nga ntya nti nnaakifiirwa, ne nsula nga sikooye ekiro kyonna nga ntya nti kinaagenda, era mazima ddala kyagenda awamu n'okuwulira okuddako n'embeera y'omutima eyaddako. Mazima nakifiirwa kubanga saanywerera ku Ye. Nnali nsenamu amazzi matono okuva mu kidiba, so nga nnali nsobola bulijjo okufuna okuva gy'ali okujjula okuyita mu misulo egyagguka. Nagenda mu nkuŋŋaana ne mpulira abantu nga boogera ku ssanyu. Nnali ndowooza nti nnina essanyu, naye saalikuuma kubanga nnali sirina Ye Yennyini nga ye ssanyu lyange. Ekiseera ne kituuka n'aŋŋamba — nga akwatiddwa ekisa — nti, "Mwana wange, twala nze bunnyini, era nzikirize okuba mu ggwe ensibuko etaggwaawo ey'ebyo byonna, Nze Kennyini." Awo bwe nnaggya amaaso gange ku kutukuzibwa kwange, ne ku kumanya kwange okwakwo, ne ngateeka ku Kristo ali mu nze, ne nsanga, mu kifo ky'okumanya, Kristo asinga ekyetaago ky'akaseera ako, Kristo eyalina byonna bye nnandyetaaze eyampeebwa mu kaseera kamu, era emirembe gyonna! Era bwe namulaba bwe ntyo, kwali kuwummula kwa ngeri! Byonna byali birungi, era birungi emirembe gyonna. Kubanga nnali sirina kyokka kye nasobola okukwata mu kaseera ako akatono, wabula ne mu Ye, byonna bye nnandyetaaze mu kaseera akaddako n'akaddako, okutuusa oluusi lwe nfuna akatangaala ku ebyo bye kiriba emyaka obukadde bwe biriggwaako, nga tuli "twakire ng'enjuba mu bwakabaka bwa Kitaffe" (Mat. 13:43), era nga tulina "okujjula kwonna okwa Katonda." Era bwe ntyo nalowooza nti n'okuwonya kwandibadde "kintu", nti Mukama yandintutte ng'essaawa enkadde eyaggwaamu, n'anzinga, n'ansindika ne ntambula ng'ekyuma. Si bwe kiri n'akatono. Nasanga nti Ye Yennyini ye yajja mu kifo ky'ekyo, n'ampa kye nnetaaga mu kaseera ako. Nnali njagala okuba n'eterekero ddene, ndyoke mpulire nga ndi mugagga; eterekero ddene erikuŋŋaanyizibwa olw'emyaka mingi, nneme okumwesigama enkya; naye teyampa terekero lya ngeri eyo. Sirina bwabwa obutukuvu newaakubadde okuwonya okusinga kwe nnetaaga mu kaseera ako. N'aŋŋamba nti: "Mwana wange, oteekwa okujja gye ndi olw'omukka ogunaddako kubanga nkwagala nnyo era njagala ojjenga bulijjo. Singa nkuwa eterekero ddene, wandikoze awatali nze so tewandijja gye ndi kaseera na kaseera; kaakano oteekwa okujja gye ndi buli kasseera, era ogalamire ku kifuba kyange buli kaseera." Yampa obugagga bungi, n'anteekerawo enkumi n'obukadde, naye n'ampa akatabo k'echeki n'ekiragiro kino kimu, "Toyinza kuggyayo kusinga kye weetaaga mu kaseera ako." Naye buli lwe waali weetaagibwa echeki, ku yo kwabaawo erinnya lya Yesu, bwe kityo ne kimuleetera ekitiibwa kingi, ne kikuuma erinnya lye mu maaso g'ensi ey'omu ggulu, era Katonda n'agulumizibwa mu Mwana we. Kyandeeteera okuyiga okuggya obulamu bwange obw'omwoyo okuva gy'ali buli kasseera, okussa Ye Yennyini nga bwe nssa omukka, ne nzza ebweru nze kennyini. Bwe kityo, buli kaseera olw'omwoyo, era buli kaseera olw'omubiri, tuteekwa okufuna. Ogamba nti, "Kino si busibe bwa ntiisa, okuba bulijjo ng'ofuba mu buzibu?" Ki, okufuba n'oyo gw'oyagala, Mukwano gwo asingayo? Nedda! Kijja mu ngeri ya bwerere, awatali kufuba, nga ensulo, awatali kwerowoozaako, awatali kufuba, kubanga obulamu obw'amazima buba bwangu bulijjo, era bujjula ne buyiika. Kaakano, Katonda yeebazibwe, mmulina, si kyokka kye nnina ekifo eky'okutereka, wabula n'ekyo kye siriiko kifo, naye kye ndifuna ekifo, buli kaseera, nga ŋŋenda mu bulamu obutaggwaawo obuli mu maaso gange. Ndi ng'akacupa akatono mu nnyanja, nga kajjudde nga bwe kayinza okukwata. Akacupa kali mu nnyanja, era n'ennyanja eri mu kacupa; bwe ntyo nange ndi mu Kristo, era Kristo ali mu nze. Naye, okwongera ku ako akajjula mu nnyanja, waliwo ennyanja yonna ennene ewala; enjawulo eri nti akacupa kalina okuddamu okujjuzibwa, buli lunaku, emirembe n'emirembe. Kaakano ekibuuzo eri buli omu ku ffe si nti "Olowooza otya ku Besusani, era olowooza otya ku kuwonya okw'Obwakatonda?" wabula nti "Olowooza otya ku Kristo?" Waatuuka ekiseera we waaliwo akantu akatono wakati wange ne Kristo. Nkinnyonnyola n'olugambo olutono lwe nnalina ne mukwano gwange eyagamba nti, "Wawonyezebwa lwa kukkiriza." "Nedda," ne ŋŋamba, "Nawonyezebwa Kristo." Enjawulo eri wa? Waliwo enjawulo nnene. Waatuuka ekiseera n'okukkiriza kwennyini kwe kwafaananako ng'okuyingira wakati wange ne Yesu. Nnalowooza nti nnina okwekolera okukkiriza, bwe ntyo ne nfuba okufuna okukkiriza. Ekiseera ne kituuka ne ndowooza nti nkufunye; nti bwe nnaakuteekako obuzito bwange bwonna, kwandikwatiridde. Bwe nnalowooza nti nfunye okukkiriza, ne ŋŋamba nti, "Mponye." Nnali neesiga nze kennyini, omutima gwange, n'okukkiriza kwange. Nnali nsaba Mukama ankolere ekintu olw'ekintu ekyali mu nze, so si olw'ekintu ekiri mu Ye. Bwe kityo Mukama n'aleka Setaani okugezesa okukkiriza kwange, era Setaani n'akulya ng'empologoma ewuluguma, ne neesanga nga ndemye ddala nga sirowooza nti nnina okukkiriza konna. Katonda n'aleka ne kuggyibwawo okutuusa lwe nawulira nti sikyalina konna. Awo Katonda n'afaanana ng'anjogeza n'ekisa nnyingi, ng'agamba nti, "Toweeraliikirira, mwana wange, tolina kintu. Naye Nze ndi Amaanyi amatuukirivu, Nze ndi Okwagala okutuukirivu, Nze ndi Okukkiriza, Nze ndi Obulamu bwo, Nze ndi okuteekateeka olw'omukisa, ate era Nze ndi n'Omukisa gwennyini. Nze ndi byonna eby'omunda ne byonna eby'ebweru, era byonna emirembe gyonna." Kwe kubeera n'"okukkiriza mu Katonda" (Makko 11:22). "N'obulamu bwe ntambulamu kaakano mu mubiri," si mu kukkiriza mu Mwana wa Katonda, wabula "mu kukkiriza okw'Omwana wa Katonda" (Bag. 2:20). Ekyo kye kikulu. Si kukkiriza kwo. Tolina kukkiriza mu ggwe, nga bw'otolina bulamu newaakubadde ekintu kirala kyonna mu ggwe. Tolina kintu wabula obwereere n'obukalu, era oteekwa okuba bwaggule era mwetegefu okumutwala akole byonna. Oteekwa okutwala okukkiriza kwe awamu n'obulamu bwe n'okuwonya kwe, era oteekwa kwogera bwogezi nti, "Ntambula mu kukkiriza okw'Omwana wa Katonda." Okukkiriza kwange tekugasa kintu. Singa mba nsaba omuntu yenna, sandyesizze ku kukkiriza kwange n'akatono. Nandigambye nti, "Laba, Mukama, nze wuuno. Bw'oyagala mbeere olubuto olutwala omukisa eri ono, mpuuwa munda yange byonna bye nneetaaga." Kristo yekka, Kristo bw'omu. Kaakano, omubiri gwo gweewaddeyo eri Kristo alyoke abeere era akolere mu ggwe bw'atyo? Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo alina omubiri nga ggwe, wabula ogugwe gutuukiridde; guba mubiri, si gw'muntu buntu, wabula gw'Omwana w'Omuntu. Wafumiitirizza ku nsonga lwaki ayitibwa Omwana w'Omuntu? Omwana w'Omuntu kitegeeza nti Yesu Kristo ye Muntu omu ow'ekyokulabirako, ajjuvu, akwata bonna, alimu byonna. Yesu ye muntu omu alina mu Ye yennyini byonna omuntu bye yandibadde n'ebyo byonna omuntu bye yandyetaaze. Byonna biri mu Kristo. Okujjula kwonna okw'Obwakatonda n'okujjula okw'obuntu obutuukiridde byassibwa mu Kristo, era kaakano ayimiridde ng'okusengekera awamu kwa byonna omuntu bye yeetaaga. Omwoyo gwe gwe byonna omwoyo gwo bye gwetaaga, era atuwa Ye Yennyini bwokka. Omubiri gwe gulina byonna omubiri gwo bye gwetaaga. Alina omutima ogukuba n'amaanyi omutima gwo ge gwetaaga. Alina ebitundu by'omubiri n'emirimu ebijjudde obulamu obungi, si ku lulwe yennyini, wabula ku lw'abantu. Yennyini teyeetaaga maanyi ku lulwe. Amaanyi agaamusobozesa okuzuukira n'okulinnya okuva mu ntaana, okusinga amaanyi gonna ag'obutonde, tegaali ku lulwe yennyini. Omubiri ogwo ogw'ekyewuunyo gugwa gwa mubiri gwo. Oli kitundu ky'omubiri gwe. Omutima gwo gulina obuyinza okusika okuva mu mutima gwe byonna bye gwetaaga. Obulamu bwo obw'omubiri bulina obuyinza okusika okuva mu bulamu bwe obw'omubiri obuwanirira n'amaanyi gaabwo, bwe kityo si ggwe, wabula bwe bulamu obw'omuwendo obw'Omwana wa Katonda. Onoomutwala bw'otyo leero, olwo tojja kuwonyezebwa kwokka, wabula ojja kuba n'obulamu obuggya olwa byonna bye weetaaga, amataba g'obulamu aganaggyawo endwadde, ne gasigala nga ensulo y'obulamu olwa byonna bye weetaaga mu maaso. Owo, mutwale mu kujjula kwe. Kimbeera ng'ennina okubaleetera leero akakuumi akatono ak'amaanyi, ng'aba nti Katonda ampadde ekyama ekitono olwa buli omu ali wano n'aŋŋamba nti, "Genda obategeeze, bwe banaakikkiriza, kinaabeera kakuumi ka maanyi buli gye banaagenda, era kinaabayisa mu buzibu, mu kabi, mu ntiisa, mu bulamu, mu kufa, ne mu bulamu obutaggwaawo." Singa nnyimirira ku ssaana lino ne ŋŋamba nti, "Nfunye okuva mu ggulu ekyama eky'obugagga n'obuwanguzi Katonda ky'anaawa buwa, okuyita mu mukono gwange, eri buli muntu anaakitwala," nkakasa nti mwandyetaaze ekizimbe ekinene okusinga olw'abantu abandizze. Naye, mikwano gyange abaagalwa, mbalaga mu Kigambo kye amazima agasinga omuwendo. Omutume Pawulo atubuulira nti waliwo ekyama, ekyama ekinene ekyakwekebwa okuva mu mirembe n'emirembe (Bak. 1:26), ensi kye yali enoonya awatali kukiraba, abasajja abagezi ab'ebuvanjuba kye baali basuubira okulaba, era Katonda agamba nti "kaakano kibikkuliddwa abatukuvu be"; era Pawulo n'ayita mu nsi ng'akibuulira abo abaali basobola okukifuna; era ekyama ekyo ekyangu kye kino nti "Kristo ali mu mmwe, essuubi ery'ekitiibwa." Ekigambo "ekyama" kitegeeza kyama; kino kye kyama ekinene. Era mbabuulira leero, weewaawo, nsobola okubawa, bwe munaakitwala okuva gy'ali, so si okuva gye ndi — nsobola okubawa ekyama ekiri gye ndi, owo, eky'ekyewuunyo bwe kityo! Emyaka mingi emabega najja gy'ali nga nzitoowereddwa omusango n'entiisa; ne ngezaako ekyama ekyangu ekyo, ne kiggyawo entiisa yange yonna n'ekibi kyange. Emyaka ne giyita, ne nsanga ekibi nga kimpangula era n'okukemebwa kwange nga kunsingira amaanyi. Najja gy'ali omulundi ogwokubiri, n'ampweekera nti, "Kristo ali mu ggwe," ne mba n'obuwanguzi, okuwummula n'omukisa. Awo omubiri ne gutyobooka mu ngeri zonna. Bulijjo nnali nkola nnyo, era okuva mu myaka kkumi n'ena nayiga ne nfuba nga sisonyiwa maanyi. Nnatwala obuvunaanyizibwa bw'ekkuŋŋaaniro eddene mu myaka amakumi abiri mu gumu; nnaggwaamu ddala emirundi nga mukaaga era mu mbeera yange ey'oluvannyuma nnali nkooye ddala. Emirundi mingi nnali ntya nti nnaagwa nga nfudde mu kifo kyange eky'okubuulirira. Saayinza kulinnya wa waggulu wonna awatali kuwulira nga sisobola kussa, olw'omutima ogwali gutyoboose n'obusimu obwali bukooye. Nawulira ku kuwonya kwa Mukama, naye ne nkulwanyisa. Nnali nkutya. Nnali nayigirizibwa mu masomero g'eby'okwesimba nti ekiseera eky'ebyamagero kyali kiyise, era saayinza kudda mabega ku byanjigiriza mu ntandikwa. Omutwe gwange gwe gwali gunziyiza, naye ekiseera ne kituuka, bwe nnaleetebwa okwenyigira mu "kuziika kwa nkola yange ey'enjigiriza enkalubo," nga bwe Mukama Schrenck agamba, "Mukama n'ampweekera ekyama ekitono, 'Kristo ali mu ggwe'; era okuva mu kaseera ako ne mmwaŋŋiriza olw'omubiri gwange nga bwe nnali nkoze olw'emmeeme yange. Nnafuulibwa ow'amaanyi era omulamu ennyo ne ntuuka okumala emirimu nga ssanyu ddala. Emyaka mingi mmaze ekiwummulo kyange eky'omu biseera eby'ebbugumu mu kibuga New York ekyokya, nga mbuulira era nga nkola mu bantu abangi, mu ngeri gye nnali sikolangamu; okwongera ku mirimu gy'Amaka gaffe n'Ekitongole ky'Amasomero n'emirimu emingi egy'omu tterekero ly'ebitabo n'ebirala bingi. Naye Mukama teyaggyawo bulumi bwange bwokka. Kyali kisingako ku kuwonya obw'engeri emu. Yampa Ye Yennyini ne ntuuka okufiirwa okuwulira okw'obulumi okw'ebitundu by'omubiri. Ekyo kye kirungi ekisinga mu bulamu bw'awa. Neebaza Mukama olw'okunkuuma okuva mu kwerowoozaako omubiri okw'obulwadde n'omubiri oguleetera okweraliikirira, n'ampa obulamu obwangu obuli ssanyu era obuweereza eri Mukama waffe, obuli kuwummula n'essanyu. Ate era, nnali n'obwongo obunafu, obuzito era obukalubo, obutaalowooza newaakubadde okukola mangu. Nnali njagala okuwandiika n'okwogera ku lwa Kristo era okuba n'okujjukira okwangu, ndyoke mbeere n'obumanyirivu obutono bwe nnali nfunye nga bulijjo bunfugibwa. Najja eri Kristo ku nsonga eyo, ne mubuuza obanga alina ky'ampa mu ngeri eno. N'anziramu nti, "Yee, mwana wange, nafuuka gye muli Amagezi." Nnali bulijjo nkola ensobi, ze nnali njejjusa, ne ndowooza nti sijja kuddamu kuzikola; naye bwe yagamba nti anaabeera amagezi gange, nti tuyinza okuba n'endowooza ya Kristo, nti asobola okusuula ebirowoozo n'okuwamba buli kirowoozo mu buwulize bwa Kristo, nti asobola okutereeza obwongo n'omutwe, awo ne mumutwalira ebyo byonna. Era okuva olwo, nnakuumibwa nga siriimu bunafu buno obw'omutwe, era omulimu gufuuse kuwummula. Nnali njawandiika nsoma bbiri buli wiiki, era kyantwalanga ennaku ssatu okumaliriza emu. Naye kaakano, mu mulimu gwange ogw'okuwandiika, nnina empapula ez'enkumu-nkumu ez'okuwandiika bulijjo okwongera ku kukulembera enkuŋŋaana ennyingi nnyo buli wiiki, era byonna bimpangira bwangu mu ssanyu. Mukama anyambye mu bwongo, era mmanyi nti ye Mulokozi w'obwongo bwaffe nga bw'ali Omulokozi w'omwoyo gwaffe. Kale nno, nnali n'obw'okusalawo obutanywevu. Ne mbuuza nti, "Tosobola kubeera kwagala gye ndi?" N'agamba nti, "Yee, mwana wange, Katonda ye akola mu ggwe okwagala n'okukola." Awo n'anjigiriza engeri n'ekiseera eky'okuba omunywevu, n'engeri n'ekiseera eky'okuwaayo. Abantu bangi balina obw'okusalawo obunywevu, naye tebamanyi ngeri ya kunywerera mu kaseera akatuufu. Bwe ntyo nange, najja gy'ali olw'amaanyi ag'omulimu gwe n'ebintu byonna eby'okuweereza kwe, era teyanninnamu. Bwe ntyo nandigambye nti, ekyama kino ekitono eky'omuwendo eky'"Kristo ali mu ggwe," bwe kinaakuyamba, oyinza okukyefunira. Osobole okukikozesa obulungi okunsinga! Mpulira nga ntandise butandisi okuyiga engeri gye kikoleramu obulungi. Kitwale weeyongere okukikola, okuyita mu biseera n'obulamu obutaggwaawo — Kristo olwa byonna, ekisa ku kisa, okuva mu maanyi okudda mu maanyi, okuva mu kitiibwa okudda mu kitiibwa, okuva kaakano n'okutuusa emirembe n'emirembe. Edda gwali mukisa, Kaakano ye Mukama; Edda kwali kuwulira, Kaakano Kye Kigambo kye. Edda nnayagala ebirabo bye, Kaakano nnina Omuwi wennyini; Edda nnanoonya kuwonya, Kaakano Ye Yennyini yekka. Edda kwali kufuba okw'obulumi, Kaakano kwe kwesiga okutuukiridde; Edda bwali bulokozi bwa kitundu, Kaakano bwe bulokozi obutuukiridde ddala. Edda kwali kunywerera okutaggwaawo, Kaakano Ye ye ankwatirira; Edda kwali kutwalibwa buli kiseera, Kaakano essikiro lyange lisuuliddwa. Edda kwali kuteekateeka okw'okwewunga, Kaakano kwe kusaba okw'obwesige; Edda kwali kweraliikirira, Kaakano Ye alina obulabirizi. Edda kye nnayagala, Kaakano Yesu ky'agamba; Edda kwali kusaba okutaggwaawo, Kaakano kwe kutendereza okutakoma. Edda gwali mulimu gwange, Kaakano gunaabeera gugwe; Edda nnagezaako okumukozesa, Kaakano Ye ankozesa. Edda amaanyi ge nnayagala, Kaakano Ow'amaanyi; Edda nnafubira nze kennyini, Kaakano ku lulwe yekka. Edda nnasuubira mu Yesu, Kaakano mmanyi nti wange; Edda ettabaaza zange zaali zizikira, Kaakano zaaka nga zimasamasa. Edda nnali nnindirira kufa, Kaakano nsanyukira okujja kwe; Era essuubi lyange linywezeddwa, nga likuumiddwa munda w'eggigi.
